metadata.question: Did nitrogen oxide concentrations in the Northern Hemisphere increase from 2019 to 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: use Sentinel-5P OFFL NO2 tropospheric column (NO2 is a proxy for NOx). Northern Hemisphere: pick a representative mid-latitude rectangle, e.g. 30–60° N, 0–30° E. Date: full years 2019 vs 2020. 2. Masking: NO2 band is already quality-screened in OFFL product; we want annual means so we’ll simply mosaic each year (mean reducer). 3. Logic: compute mean NO2 tropospheric column for 2019 and 2020 over the same region. If both values are valid numbers and 2020 > 2019 then A, else B. If any collection is empty → C1; if valid-pixel count is 0 after processing → C2; if either mean is None/NaN → C3. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time geom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle(0, 30, 30, 60) # mid-latitude N.Hemisphere box scale = 3000 def annual_no2(year): col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') \ .filterBounds(geom) \ .filterDate(f'{year}-01-01', f'{year+1}-01-01') \ .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density') if col.size().getInfo() == 0: return None mean = col.mean().multiply(1e6) # mol/m² -> µmol/m² stats = mean.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True), geometry=geom, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9) val = stats.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo() cnt = stats.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo() return val, cnt no2_2019 = annual_no2(2019) no2_2020 = annual_no2(2020) if no2_2019 is None or no2_2020 is None: print("Missing collection for at least one year.") print("C1") else: v19, c19 = no2_2019 v20, c20 = no2_2020 print(f"2019: {v19:.2f} µmol/m² (pixels: {c19})") print(f"2020: {v20:.2f} µmol/m² (pixels: {c20})") if None in [v19, v20] or any(c == 0 for c in [c19, c20]): print("C2>" if 0 in [c19, c20] else "C3") else: print("A" if v20 > v19 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
geom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle(0, 30, 30, 60)  # mid-latitude N.Hemisphere box
scale = 3000

def annual_no2(year):
    col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') \
             .filterBounds(geom) \
             .filterDate(f'{year}-01-01', f'{year+1}-01-01') \
             .select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density')
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None
    mean = col.mean().multiply(1e6)  # mol/m² -> µmol/m²
    stats = mean.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', True),
        geometry=geom, scale=scale, maxPixels=1e9)
    val = stats.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_mean').getInfo()
    cnt = stats.get('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count').getInfo()
    return val, cnt

no2_2019 = annual_no2(2019)
no2_2020 = annual_no2(2020)

if no2_2019 is None or no2_2020 is None:
    print("Missing collection for at least one year.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    v19, c19 = no2_2019
    v20, c20 = no2_2020
    print(f"2019: {v19:.2f} µmol/m² (pixels: {c19})")
    print(f"2020: {v20:.2f} µmol/m² (pixels: {c20})")
    if None in [v19, v20] or any(c == 0 for c in [c19, c20]):
        print("<answer>C2></answer>" if 0 in [c19, c20] else "<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        print("<answer>A</answer>" if v20 > v19 else "<answer>B</answer>")
